scene: public EPIC-KITCHENS P03_28 egocentric bottle workspace
coordinate_convention: screen-left/screen-right are camera-image directions; they are not silently relabeled as robot-base coordinates
handover_generation_prompt: Two coherent white and brushed-silver robot arms perform a complete bottle handover above the kitchen sink. The blue bottle begins in the screen-right robot gripper, both grippers contact it at center, then the screen-right fingers fully open and withdraw to the right. The blue bottle ends visibly enclosed and supported only by the screen-left robot gripper for the final two seconds. The screen-right gripper is empty and separated. Preserve bottle identity and stable robot geometry. No human hands.

human_review: screen-left fingers visibly close around and support the bottle before release
screen-right fingers visibly open and the empty gripper separates
the bottle stays with the screen-left gripper throughout the final two seconds

actions.label: handover-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the screen-right robot hand, bring it to the center, transfer it into the screen-left robot hand, fully release it from the screen-right hand, separate the hands, and hold the bottle only in the screen-left hand.

phases.name: present
phases.description: preserve the screen-right grasp and bring the upright blue bottle to the center while the screen-left hand opens

phases.name: dual-contact
phases.description: close the screen-left fingers around the bottle while the screen-right hand keeps contact

phases.name: transfer
phases.description: establish screen-left support, then fully open and release the screen-right fingers

phases.name: separate
phases.description: move the empty screen-right hand away while the screen-left hand holds the bottle

phases.name: display
phases.description: hold the bottle visibly in only the screen-left hand while the empty screen-right gripper stays separated

actions.label: unscrew-bottle-cap
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the screen-right robot hand, stabilize the bottle body, twist the cap counterclockwise with the screen-left gripper, lift the separated cap, inspect it, and finish with the open bottle and detached cap visibly apart.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial screen-right bottle grasp

phases.name: center-bottle
phases.description: bring the upright blue bottle to the center without releasing it

phases.name: grasp-cap
phases.description: close the screen-left gripper on the cap while the screen-right gripper stabilizes the bottle body

phases.name: unscrew
phases.description: rotate the screen-left wrist counterclockwise without rotating the bottle body

phases.name: remove-cap
phases.description: lift the fully separated cap while the screen-right gripper holds the open bottle

phases.name: separate-and-inspect
phases.description: keep the cap detached in the screen-left gripper and separate both hands

phases.name: display-open-state
phases.description: finish with the open bottle in the screen-right hand and detached cap in the screen-left, visibly separated

actions.label: rinse-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the screen-right robot hand, move it under the faucet, use the screen-left robot hand to operate the faucet, rotate and sweep the bottle through several rinsing orientations, then move it out of the water while keeping the grasp.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial screen-right bottle grasp

phases.name: move-under-faucet
phases.description: move the bottle directly below the visible faucet

phases.name: operate-faucet
phases.description: reach the faucet control with the screen-left gripper

phases.name: rotate-rinse
phases.description: rotate and sweep the same bottle beneath the faucet while maintaining the screen-right grasp

phases.name: remove-from-water
phases.description: return the bottle upright and move it away from the faucet

phases.name: drain-and-hold
phases.description: make a small draining tilt above the basin and hold the rinsed bottle without release
